commands.sentence: Count the memory notes in both layers and name any layer it cannot read: Writes nothing; refuses an unknown sub-verb.
Write one memory note, its body read from stdin: Writes ~/.abcd.noindex/memory.json only; refuses a secret, a network address or a private name.
commands.example: abcd memory add --title "The tests need the race flag" --recall test --recall race --by Example:model-1 < note.txt

commands.sentence: List every memory note with its body, recall words, stamps and reach: Writes nothing; refuses any argument.
Remove one personal memory note, whoever wrote it: Writes ~/.abcd.noindex/memory.json only; refuses a note in the project's file.
